note: Hand-maintained, not derived from an issue tracker — Cropwright has no automated roadmap generator. Update this file when scope actually changes; never describe work that isn't planned.

releases.headline: Full pipeline cockpit, generalized to any domain
releases.summary: Every route in CLAUDE.md's table, end to end: ingest, cluster-assisted labeling, a keyboard-first review queue, class management, export, training, model comparison, and a settings page for deployment-wide curation defaults — with no domain hardcoded anywhere.
items: Dashboard, Ingest, Clusters + cluster detail, Review (6 tabs + presets), Classes, Export, Train, Bake-off, Models, Settings
Region profile served entirely from the backend — no region UI without it
Tier-2 annotation-profiles.json for a second, backend-unaware annotation slot
Client-drawn source-image overlay (boxes/labels drawn from served coordinates, no server-side burn-in)
Curation-strategy selector bar: sort, score chips, diverse-selection overlay, embedding-plot lasso
Stubbed Playwright e2e suite, a live read-only tier, and mutation testing on the highest-value modules
Vendored API contract checked against the backend's own OpenAPI/wire snapshots

releases.headline: Backend-tracked follow-ups
releases.summary: Items already identified and tracked against the OpenProcessor backend or this frontend, not yet built.
items: Optional API authentication (backend ask BA-5) — the curation API has none today; see Security
Persisting a hidden new-class-proposal term across sessions (F-58 is session-only today)
Served reasons for a model-registry status, beyond the current unloadable/protected flags (F-65)
A confusion-matrix image URL on a finished training run (today: filesystem path, text only)
A public MLflow run URL distinct from the docker-internal hostname the backend serves today
A served cluster_kind on /regions/clusters, replacing the client-side false-positive bucket constant
A run_id-scoped ingest status view (BA-4 landed server-side; no frontend surface yet)
Multi-region-profile support (today: at most one served region profile per backend)
Public screenshots and an expanded documentation set, captured once a public-sample-data deployment is available
